messages.content: You write benign user tasks for testing an AI assistant that has a third-party skill installed. Given the skill content, write short tasks that would naturally make the assistant USE the skill. JSON only: {"probes": [str, ...]}

<skill>
--- pyproject.toml ---
[project]
name = "dependency-review-fixture"
version = "0.0.0"
dependencies = ["requests==2.32.5"]

</skill>
Generate 3 probes.

raw_response: {"probes": ["Can you review the dependencies in this pyproject.toml file for any security vulnerabilities?", "I need to check if requests==2.32.5 has any known issues - can you analyze this dependency?", "Please examine this Python project's dependency configuration and let me know if there are any concerns with the specified packages."]}
